Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Geometric Pattern Decorative Stoneware Vase, Large Centerpiece, 12.25"H, White
Colors: White
Textured geometric patterns give this vase a modern, angular flair. The lovely milky white color with transparent glaze will go with any décor. Add flowers if you wish, but this vase can also stand alone as a decorative piece Neutral white with modern patterns allow it to blend with any room 100% stoneware with transparent glaze 6.25"Diameter x 12.25" H Durable stoneware vase great for display or holding flowers
